product_metadata.title: Madison Park Micro Splendor Color Fast, Wrinkle Resistant, Soft Sheets with 12" Deep Pocket All Season, Cozy Bedding-Set, Matching Pillow Case, Queen, Red
features: The Micro Splendor Ultra Soft Wrinkle Free Microfiber Sheet Set is a practical bedding solution.
This Sheet is made of ultra soft microfiber that's wrinkle and fade resistant and offers exceptional comfort all year round.
It comes with all-around elastic on 12" deep fitted sheet for snug and securely fits mattress sizes, up to a 14" mattress depth.
Set includes: 1 Flat Sheet: 90"W x 102"L, 1 Fitted Sheet: 60"W x 80"L + 12"D, 2 Standard Pillowcases: 21"W x 30"L
Care instructions: machine wash cold, gentle cycle, and separately
description: The micro splendor sheet collection is a practical bedding solution. Micro splendor is made with a durable, premium microfiber with colors that will not fade throughout the life of the product. This value priced collection is available in a wide array of colors that combine classic design with a bestselling color palette. Available in ivory, khaki, blue, Red, green and black.
